chapter.heading: Job 2
Satan Attacks Job’s Health
chapter.v: there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came among them to present himself before the Lord .
And the Lord said to Satan, “From where have you come?” Satan answered the Lord and said, “From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking up and down on it.”
Then Satan answered the Lord and said, “Skin for skin! All that a man has he will give for his life.
And the Lord said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand; only spare his life.”
